verses.text: For the one directing. According to “The Doe of the Dawn.” A Psalm of David. My God, my God, why have You forsaken me, far away from my salvation, [from] the words of my roaring?

verses.text: And I [am] a worm, and not a man, the scorn of men, and despised by the people.
